C-CLIPBOARD-CAPTURE-SINGLE-SOURCE.Summary: Make the existing ESM clipboard capture core the single authored source and deterministically generate its file-URL-safe classic browser artifact, preserving both public APIs and enforcing generated-file freshness on the technical-debt lane.
C-CLIPBOARD-CAPTURE-SINGLE-SOURCE.Problem: Structural technical debt UNIFY:F-004. tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.js is imported as ESM by tests while tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.browser.js is loaded as a plain script by the standalone page; both independently maintain the same 23 capture/payload/issue helper functions. The prior check of 12 families / 84 comparisons found equal results and no functional divergence is claimed; the defect is duplicated maintained ownership and the absence of a mandatory generated-artifact freshness boundary, so every future fix must be ported to two places by hand.
C-CLIPBOARD-CAPTURE-SINGLE-SOURCE.Relationship: Derived from backlog record UNIFY:F-004. Delivery is structural: integ/techdebt lane, current collecting lane or the next unused td-N ledger; the earlier td-1 is already merged and must not be reused, and lane departure into main stays a separate explicit owner instruction. This change is independent of C-PELE-HTML-POSTPROCESS and C-EXTERNAL-RELOAD-OPERATION; no shared files, lane ledger or verification anchors overlap beyond the shared lane protocol. It populates the currently placeholder M-044 contract and V-M-044 verification and does not touch the product current pointer, release, signing or C-50.

Goals.Goal: Keep tools/clipboard-capture/capture-core.js as the single authored implementation of capture rules. Derive capture-core.browser.js deterministically using the already installed Vite transformWithEsbuild API plus a small static classic-script wrapper, with no runtime imports and no server requirement.

Preserve the exact existing nine ESM exports and the exact five-member globalThis.ClipboardCaptureCore browser API in its former order; the generated wrapper projects those five functions without exposing new public keys, installing Node globals or moving capture logic into the adapter.

Commit the generated classic artifact so a downloaded repository ZIP still opens tools/clipboard-capture/index.html directly through file:// without Node, npm or a user build. Add a read-only --check freshness mode that fails for missing, stale or manually edited artifacts and is exercised by ordinary tests and V-M-044.
Route the structural work through integ/techdebt under the existing lane protocol; lane admission is distinct from later explicit owner departure into main and product-train accounting.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not change capture algorithms, schema/version values, text/MIME ordering, normalization, trimming, metadata-only file/item handling, record/history keys, filenames, issue packet/URL content, truncation, UUID/random/time/platform fallback behavior or exception handling. Contract/map/ownership comments may be synchronized.

Preserve all nine ESM export names: TOOL_SCHEMA_VERSION, HISTORY_SCHEMA_VERSION, KNOWN_TEXT_TYPES, normalizeLineEndings, buildCaptureRecord, buildHistoryEnvelope, createExportFilename, buildIssuePacket, buildIssueUrl. Preserve the browser keys and their order: buildCaptureRecord, buildHistoryEnvelope, createExportFilename, buildIssuePacket, buildIssueUrl.
Use current locked dev tooling only: no new npm/Cargo dependencies, no package/lock changes, no new user build command. Runtime page loading consumes the committed artifact without a generator.

Generated output carries a generated-from notice and stable source/tool provenance, repository-relative identity, fixed transform options, LF, and no source maps, timestamps, machine paths, nondeterministic metadata, eval, runtime module imports or external resources. Normalize source line endings for generation identity without rewriting the canonical file, so Windows checkout LF/CRLF conversion cannot stale the output; identical source plus fixed lock/toolchain yields identical generated bytes.

Provide explicit --check and --write maintenance modes. --check compares expected bytes and fails without writing; --write changes only the known generated artifact after successful generation. Test helpers operate on inert strings/temporary copies and never edit tracked canonical/generated files to simulate drift.

The freshness check participates in ordinary renderer tests without workflow or global build-hook changes, so changing only one side cannot pass relevant verification. Tests execute the actual generated classic script and its five exports; compiler invocation alone is not behavior proof.

Keep index.html, app.js and styles.css byte-identical. Do not alter the page UI, storage behavior, browser clipboard/paste APIs, issue handoff/navigation logic or application smart-paste behavior, and do not claim raw OS clipboard envelope or binary file-content capture.

Generation/wrapper code owns adaptation only: no separately maintained copy of normalization, payload collection, metadata, filename or issue formatting logic. Update the M-044 contract from its placeholder and populate V-M-044 commands/scenarios while preserving legacy expectations.

Security boundary for automated checks: the browser file-URL test loads the real page over file:// with HTTP(S) requests denied, feeds a synthetic paste, and intercepts clipboard/download/navigation with inert adapters. No system clipboard, owner/user files or live GitHub request is touched, no owner browser or application state is changed.

Implement sequentially. Before lane work, resolve a fresh collecting lane or allocate the next unused td-N; never reuse merged td-1. Declare exact lane ledger paths in the approved plan, keep the product current pointer unchanged, run full lane checks and record a separate lane admission commit. Only explicit owner instruction departs a frozen lane, via the existing reviewed merge-commit protocol plus carrier bookkeeping.
No new workflow/Playwright configuration, retries/skips/floor reductions, production deployment, signing, version/tag, GitHub issue creation or external messaging.

ObservedWriteScope.Exclusivity: Nine declared files, exactly as in the review. Any additional file required by implementation must be declared and approved before the plan, never added silently. Lane ledger paths are resolved by the approved plan; product current.json and historical merged lane bundles stay unchanged.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No clipboard feature or schema change, OS-native capture, capture UI redesign, record migration, general bundler/transpiler service, or conversion of the standalone page to module-script/server delivery.
No new direct-main exception for technical debt, no reuse of a merged lane ID, no release authorization, no change to the product current train selection.
No claim that the prior 12-family/84-comparison parity is universal equivalence, and no claim that a headless macOS file-URL run proves Windows/Edge manual acceptance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Inventory shows one authored implementation of all 23 existing functions. The browser file is reproducibly derived from the canonical ESM implementation plus static wrapper; changing canonical input without regeneration, deleting the browser artifact or editing it manually makes --check and relevant tests fail with no writes.

Two generations from identical source/toolchain, and from LF versus CRLF source controls, produce byte-identical output with stable provenance and no absolute paths or time-dependent content. Generated JavaScript is a classic script defining only the expected browser namespace API, with no runtime import/export/eval/remote dependency.

All existing six ESM tests are preserved, plus actual generated-browser/ESM characterization of the twelve existing input families: MIME/custom types, duplicates, CR/LF/Unicode, advertised empty HTML, file/item metadata, getData failure, array-like types, missing fields, platform override, fallback identity and large payload, with per-realm clock/identity/platform control and complete record/history/filename/packet/URL comparison, without changing production APIs.

Direct API-shape/ordering controls cover the browser five and ESM nine exports and unchanged canonical capture-rule statements. A meaningful drift/mutation control proves an unregenerated browser artifact cannot pass the freshness check; no invented pre-existing functional failure is used to label the refactor red/green.

An actual isolated Chromium file:// page loads the committed generated core before app.js, receives a synthetic paste and produces the expected capture/JSON/packet results without a dev server, with HTTP(S) denied and clipboard/download/navigation side effects intercepted by inert adapters. The existing non-macOS Chrome/Edge manual open-from-disk/export expectation remains distinct mandatory acceptance or an explicit owner-approved exception.

M-044/V-M-044 identify canonical source, generated artifact, generator, read-only freshness command, generated-browser behavior tests and file-URL acceptance; legacy capture/body/OS-format boundaries and source-family follow-ups are preserved, and no empty current verification entry is replaced by unexecuted pass claims.

Generator freshness, ESM/generated-core suites, file-URL browser check, current/target/final lifecycle commands, ordinary deterministic review/commit/push checks and full exact-head lane hosted checks pass. The existing test workflow already targets integ/techdebt; CI is not changed to bypass a lane gate.

Apply/archive follows fresh results and its explicit decision. Admission follows the technical-debt protocol; main delivery stays open until authorized lane departure and complete carrier accounting. Owned browser/test processes are cleaned up, source/recipe/hash/results preserved, shared caches and owner data untouched.

Installed Vite exposes transformWithEsbuild and the current test workflow includes integ/techdebt for push/pull_request. These facts are recorded in the private proof; the implementation must not introduce a new runtime compiler requirement for ZIP users.
